newsitem.title: UK: Premier League seeks more Sky TV cash - paper.
newsitem.headline: Premier League seeks more Sky TV cash - paper.

text.p: Soccer Premier League is set to demand more money from British Sky Broadcasting Group Plc (BSkyB) for television rights next year when digital TV is launched, the London Evening Standard newspaper reported on Thursday.
A Premier League spokesman was reported in the newspaper as saying: "Football on digital terrestrial (TV) would require our agreement and would have to involve additional income for football."
The Premier League was unavailable for comment.

The Premier league has a current four-year agreement with Rupert Murdoch's News Corp -owned BSkyB. The deal, worth 670 million pounds, begins at the start of the next season in August and runs until 2001.
